description: check-prose long-paragraph(>6s) counts sentence FRAGMENTS per wrapped source line, not real sentences: a 3-sentence paragraph wrapped across 6 lines with mid-line sentence ends read as 7. Also: moving a complexity-grandfathered function to a new file re-exposes noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity (grandfather list is per-file).
resolution: Align sentence boundaries to line ends, avoid '..' in prose, and refactor moved functions below complexity 15 rather than adding to biome.json overrides.

content: When a warren union merge pushes files past the 500-line check:size budget, fix by splitting cohesive slices into sibling dotted-grouping modules and re-exporting so import paths stay stable (see analytics.projection.ts, run-metrics.economics.test.ts from warren-ea4e). For check:bundle-size, raw bytes are toolchain-stable but the pod's bun (1.2.23) gzips cooler than CI's (.bun-version 1.3.14); install bun 1.3.14 (~/.local/bin), rm -rf src/ui/node_modules, rebuild frozen, then check:bundle-size --update auto-raises within cap. Budget edits are never hand-written. Also: jscpd allowlist pairs must track where duplicated code moves (scripts/dups-allowlist.json), and stale __golden__ analytics fixtures must be regenerated with WARREN_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1.
